body.condition: \(\dim\ker\widetilde T_a(P')^*=\dim\ker\widetilde T_a(P)^*\) for every \(P'\in\mathcal V_P\) and \(a=0,1\).

novel.justification: Fixed cokernel dimension is satisfied away from singular-value crossings in finite categorical and fiberwise finite-proxy designs and allows treatment bridges to remain nonunique.
